seoul.hazards: Typhoon swells, summer crowds, cold winter water
seoul.waterTemp: 41-79 F, 3/2 mm to 5/4 mm in winter
seoul.breaks: Jukdo Beach in Yangyang (beach, beginner-intermediate, Jun-Nov); Songjeong in Busan (beach, beginner-intermediate, Jun-Nov)

edinburgh.hazards: Cold water, rips, short waves in onshore wind
edinburgh.waveSize: 2-4 ft; 6+ ft in big winter swells
edinburgh.waterTemp: 43-57 F, 5/4 mm hooded wetsuit in winter
edinburgh.breaks: Belhaven Bay at Dunbar (beach, beginner, Sep-Mar); Pease Bay (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Mar); Coldingham Bay (beach, intermediate, Sep-Mar)

istanbul.hazards: Cold Black Sea water, strong rips, unreliable swell, wind chop
istanbul.waveSize: 1-3 ft; up to 6 ft in winter storms

hokkaido.hazards: Very cold water, rips, ice floes in deep winter
hokkaido.waterTemp: 36-68 F, 5/4 mm to 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit in winter

chiapas.waveSize: 3-6 ft; 8+ ft in summer southern swells
chiapas.breaks: Puerto Arista (beach, intermediate-expert, Apr-Oct); Boca del Cielo (river mouth, intermediate, Apr-Oct)

borneo.hazards: Small inconsistent waves, crocodiles at river mouths, wind chop
borneo.waveSize: Knee to waist high; rarely above chest

amsterdam.hazards: Cold North Sea, short wind-driven waves, piers and groynes
amsterdam.waterTemp: 39-68 F, 5/4 mm hooded wetsuit in winter
amsterdam.breaks: Zandvoort (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Mar); Bloemendaal aan Zee (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Mar); Wijk aan Zee (beach, intermediate, Sep-Mar)

tokyo-kyoto.hazards: Typhoon swells, crowded breaks, cold winter water
tokyo-kyoto.breaks: Shonan at Kamakura and Enoshima (beach, beginner-intermediate, Aug-Nov); Ichinomiya in Chiba (beach, intermediate-expert, Aug-Nov); Kujukuri (beach, intermediate, Sep-Nov)

southeast-alaska.hazards: Freezing water, bears, remote, big surf
southeast-alaska.waterTemp: 37-55 F, 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with boots and gloves

rome.hazards: Small wind-driven waves, polluted water after rain, summer crowds
rome.breaks: Ostia (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar); Fregene (beach, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Mar)

falklands.hazards: Freezing water, strong wind, remote, kelp
falklands.waterTemp: 37-50 F, 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with boots and gloves
falklands.breaks: Surf Bay near Stanley (beach, intermediate-expert, year-round)

bordeaux.hazards: Strong rips, cold water in winter, summer crowds, shifting sandbars
bordeaux.waterTemp: 50-68 F, 4/3 mm to 5/4 mm in winter
bordeaux.breaks: Lacanau Ocean (beach, beginner-expert, Sep-Apr); Montalivet (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr); Soulac (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr)

snowdonia.hazards: Cold water, strong tides and rips, crowds on summer weekends
snowdonia.waterTemp: 46-61 F, 4/3 mm to 5/4 mm in winter
snowdonia.breaks: Llangennith on the Gower (beach, beginner-expert, Sep-Apr); Rest Bay at Porthcawl (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr); Porth Neigwl on the Llyn Peninsula (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr)

upper-peninsula.hazards: Near-freezing water, cold air, storms, fast-changing weather
upper-peninsula.waterTemp: 34-68 F, 5/4 mm to 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with boots and gloves
upper-peninsula.breaks: Marquette Picnic Rocks area on Lake Superior (beach, intermediate-expert, Oct-Nov)

tuscany.hazards: Small wind swell, long flat spells, summer crowds
tuscany.breaks: Viareggio (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar); Marina di Pisa (beach, beginner-intermediate, Oct-Mar); Forte dei Marmi (beach, beginner, Oct-Mar)

quebec-city.hazards: Cold fast river water, rocks, ice in spring
quebec-city.breaks: Habitat 67 standing wave on the St Lawrence in Montreal (river wave, intermediate-expert, May-Oct)

napa.hazards: Cold water, great white sharks, strong rips, fog
napa.breaks: Salmon Creek on the Sonoma Coast (beach, intermediate-expert, Sep-Apr); Doran Beach at Bodega Bay (beach, beginner, May-Oct)

andalucia.hazards: Strong wind and kite traffic at Tarifa, rips, crowded summer beaches
andalucia.breaks: Tarifa Los Lances (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr); El Palmar at Vejer (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr); Conil (beach, beginner, Sep-Apr); Zahara de los Atunes (beach, beginner-intermediate, Sep-Apr)

gbr.hazards: Stingers, crocodiles, reef; very little surf, waves are small and wind-driven
gbr.waterTemp: 75-86 F, boardshorts and a stinger suit

aruba.hazards: Strong trade wind, shallow reef, kite and windsurf traffic
aruba.waveSize: Knee to chest high; rarely above shoulder

bavaria-munich.waveSize: Standing river wave about 3 ft high, fixed size

seychelles.waveSize: 2-4 ft; 6+ ft in the southeast monsoon

kerala.waveSize: 2-4 ft; bigger in the southwest monsoon

rivieramaya.waveSize: Ankle to knee high; rarely rideable

cape-cod-islands.breaks: Nauset Light Beach (beach, intermediate, Aug-Nov); Coast Guard Beach (beach, intermediate, Aug-Nov); Surfside on Nantucket (beach, beginner, Jun-Sep)
